title.value: Memory-Aware Functional IR for Higher-Level Synthesis of Accelerators
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the content of the paper as it discusses the development of a memory-aware functional intermediate representation (IR) for the synthesis of accelerators on FPGAs.
title.quote: Specialized accelerators deliver orders of a magnitude of higher performance than general-purpose processors....

extractions.description: This scientific paper presents a novel Intermediate Representation (IR) for higher-level synthesis of accelerators, specifically focusing on addressing the challenges of programming FPGAs. It details the development of Shir, a memory-aware, multi-level functional IR that aids in automating the design and generation of FPGA hardware from high-level descriptions. The paper elaborates on the IR's ability to efficiently manage memory operations and hardware parallelism, ultimately leading to competitive performance against manually optimized hardware design languages such as OpenCL.
